service: Standard bare PCB fabrication; self assembly or supplied JLCPCB assembly inputs
via_covering: Epoxy filled and copper capped, all plated round holes 0.20/0.30/0.40 mm; preserve supplied mask openings
esp32_centre_joint: MINI-1 pad 49 omitted: masked GND land, no paste or thermal holes; all 21 perimeter GND pads soldered
keyboard: Delivered attached; preserve functional bridge and mouse bites
status: Production files for five engineering prototypes; stocked NFC substitutes screened by models; rev-A copper and matching values retained. Physical RF/USB/display bring-up remains required.
routing_review: Strict routing audit outside unchanged rev-A NFC; legacy NFC geometric findings retained to preserve tested design.

battery_connector.entry: Side entry, opening toward left board edge (-X), cable parallel to PCB
battery_connector.substitution: No PH, ZH, or top-entry SH substitute. Previous PH battery plug is incompatible.
battery_connector.peak_current_assumption: User accepts intermittent excursions above 1 A for this prototype; no current limiter or operating restriction added. This does not constitute a manufacturer pulse rating.

battery_solder_pads.pin_1: VBAT positive, right pad at (56.1,96.0) mm
battery_solder_pads.assembly: Hand solder only; no paste, BOM or placement entry
battery_solder_pads.connection: Parallel with J2; use one battery connection at a time

esp32_module.firmware: ESP-IDF 5.4+ recommended; see docs/esp32-mini.md for supported older versions

mounting_holes.fastener: M2 clearance; through screw and separate nut or threaded standoff
mounting_holes.assembly: Hardware supplied separately; holes excluded from BOM, CPL and stencil; select screw length for actual stackup
